fact: On 20 October 2025 SOCOF (DRC) and TTCL (Tanzania) confirmed the Kalemie-Kigoma Lake Tanganyika fibre link (160-186 km, 100 Gbps), with works due to start in early 2026 and service by end 2027, under a confidentiality agreement signed in February 2023.
title: RDC-Tanzanie : une interconnexion en fibre optique qui pourrait transformer la région
